title: I'm looking for a developer I can interview sometime.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
I'm trying to get a simple magazine style website running about RPG maker game development. On this website I will attempt to write articles about RPG maker related subjects. I will review games here, and I will review graphics, too.
Once in a while (maybe once a month) I would like to interview a developer who uses RPG maker. This will be a written article, so we can do the interview in a chat, or in a discord voice call. In case of a discord call, the call will be recorded, so I can type it out later. The recording will then be deleted.
The interview is about what development means to you, and about what you develop. This will include a direct link to your website, your project or your webshop if you have those links available. A screenshot or two can be added to show your work.
A photo of you to post with the interview is optional, but that would be very nice for the interview.
An interview will take 30 to 60 minutes, depending on how much of a talker you are. Some people say a lot in 10 minutes, while others take an hour to say less.
If you are interested in being interviewed, let me know in a comment below. I would like a few things when you apply:
How long have you been using RPG maker?
Have you ever released something? If yes, what was it?
For the first interview, I prefer someone who's already well known with the software. Therefor, if more than one dev wants to be interviewed, I might choose the developer with the most experience.

posts.author: Poryg
posts.body:
First used RPG maker in 2009. Eventually dropped it as I wasn't particularly creative.
I returned to rpg maker at 2015. But let's say, I gave more to the community than to my projects.
So far the only "game" I've ever released was an arena 1v1 multiplayer "game". It wasn't anything worth talking about, just a "proof of concept" that you can (although you shouldn't by any means) make a multiplayer game with 2 player simultaneous control in RPG maker 2003.
Currently I'm mostly gone from rpg maker. I use the app as a tool to facilitate my game development, but due to the developments of MV and MZ my relationship with the engine has soured and I likely won't make games directly in it.
